name: mcp-mail-tester
description: Write-only, rate-limited, recipient-constrained email capability exposed to an LLM as an MCP server on Cloudflare Workers.

SMTP_HOST.description: Your SMTP provider's host, e.g. smtp.example.com. Port 465 (implicit TLS) by default; set SMTP_PORT=587 for STARTTLS.

SMTP_USERNAME.description: The SMTP account's address; also the sender unless SMTP_FROM is set.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: An SMTP app-specific password, not the account's login password.

EMAIL_PER_MIN.description: Most emails the model may send in any 60 seconds, across all connections (an integer > 0).

MAIL_ALLOW_TO.description: Comma-separated bare addresses the model may email. Anything else goes to the first entry (or MAIL_DEFAULT_TO).
